product_metadata.title: Enesco Disney Traditions by Jim Shore Pinocchio Jiminy Cricket Miniature Figurine, 2.75", Multicolor
features: “Mini Jiminy Cricket” figurine from the Disney Traditions collection by Jim Shore
Combines classic Disney characters with folk art designs
Figurine captures Jiminy Cricket from Walt Disney’s “Pinocchio” in beautiful hand-painted detail
Accurate details handcrafted in high-quality stone resin
description: The Disney Traditions collection by Jim Shore combines the magic of Disney with time-honored folk art motifs. “One night a long time ago. ” Jiminy Cricket prepares to tell the tale of Walt Disney’s “Pinocchio” in this mini hand-painted figurine, lustrous eyes shining and red umbrella in hand. Handcrafted from stone resin with an impeccable eye for detail, the 2. 75” design is full of delights. Shore’s whimsical rosemaling adds artisanal charm “Pinocchio” lovers and folk art aficionados will cherish forever. About Us: Enesco is committed to bringing joy every day. The premier global destination for high-quality giftware, and home décor, our prestigious family of brands includes: Department 56 Village, Things Remembered, Foundations, Jim Shore Heartwood Creek, Disney Traditions by Jim Shore, Walt Disney Archives Collection, Disney Showcase Collection, Disney by Britto, Pusheen, Designs by Lolita, Our Name Is Mud, and many more.
